extraction.name: MVBench
extraction.description: MVBench is a comprehensive multi-modal video understanding benchmark covering 20 challenging video tasks that cannot be effectively solved with a single frame. It uses a static-to-dynamic method to define temporal-related tasks and automatically converts public video annotations into multiple-choice QA format. It evaluates temporal understanding skills of MLLMs ranging from perception to cognition.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Videos were selected from 11 existing video datasets covering diverse domains and scenes. An automatic QA generation paradigm was designed to convert open-sourced video annotations into multiple-choice QAs. Data filtration was applied based on video diversity, temporal sensitivity (duration 5s-35s), and question difficulty. QA generation used ChatGPT to generate questions and either template-based construction or LLM-based generation for answer options.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Videos and annotations from 11 existing video datasets covering a broad spectrum of domains and scenes, ranging from first-person to third-person perspectives, and from indoor to outdoor environments.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automatic QA generation paradigm using LLMs (ChatGPT) to convert existing video annotations into multiple-choice QAs. Two approaches: (1) Template-Based Construction from ground truth annotations, and (2) LLM-Based Generation for specific tasks. Videos filtered for diversity, temporal sensitivity, and question difficulty.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: ChatGPT used to automatically generate questions and answer options for multiple-choice QAs from existing video annotations
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Videos are filtered for diversity, temporal sensitivity (duration 5s-35s), and question difficulty. For STAR, start/end points are randomly shifted to increase complexity. For CLEVRER, questions requiring more than 10 conditions are excluded. QA options are constructed via template-based construction or LLM-based generation using ChatGPT.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Video annotations from 11 existing datasets are automatically converted into multiple-choice QA format using LLMs (ChatGPT). Questions are generated based on task definitions, and answer options are constructed either via template-based construction from ground truth annotations or LLM-based generation. All data samples are reorganized in a uniform format with keys for vision data path and QA.
